import redis.asyncio as redis
from pyrate_limiter import Duration, Rate, Limiter, RedisBucket

redis_client = redis.Redis(host="localhost", port=6379, db=0)
rates = [Rate(5, Duration.MINUTE)]
bucket = RedisBucket("my-prefix", redis_client, max_size=5, leak_rate=2)
limiter = Limiter(rates, bucket_factory=lambda *_: bucket)
await limiter.try_acquire("user_123")

import asyncio
from limits import RateLimitItemFixedWindow
from limits.aio.strategies import FixedWindowRateLimiter
from limits.aio.storage import RedisStorage

storage = await RedisStorage.from_url("redis://localhost:6379")
limiter = FixedWindowRateLimiter(storage)
limit = RateLimitItemFixedWindow(10, 1, 60)

if await limiter.hit(limit, "unique_user_id"):
    pass # Allowed
